Container.Name: MoneySite
Container.Overview: Personal money manager: transactions, income vs spending, net worth, credit cards and investments, synced from your banks through Plaid. WARNING: there is no login. Keep it on your home network only and never port-forward it.
Container.Requires: A Plaid account (client ID and secret). To move existing data in, use Accounts, Backup & restore in the app.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Web page port. Home network only: never port-forward it.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Holds money.db: your transactions, settings and Plaid access tokens. Created automatically.

Config.Name: Plaid Client ID
Config.Description: From the Plaid dashboard (Developers, Keys). Use the same one the app was linked with, or banks must be re-linked.

Config.Name: Plaid Environment
Config.Description: production for real banks (Plaid's Trial plan is production); sandbox for test data.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Your time zone. Sets what counts as today and where months start.

Config.Name: Database Path
Config.Description: Where the database lives inside the container. Leave as is.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata folder and runs the app. 99 is nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the appdata folder. 100 is users.
